title: Figure 8 (20610): aeronautical chart of witness line of sight toward Brownwood MOA
description: Google Earth image of an aeronautical sectional chart around Comanche, Dublin and Lake Proctor, Texas, showing airports, airways and military operating area boundaries. Caption: "Figure 8 (20610) Witnesses line of sight (begins NW of Comanche 10 miles) led his view across Lake Proctor toward area of other sightings and is itself well into the Brownwood Military Operating Area as shown." Below is a highlighted witness account headed "20616 – Hico" describing at least seven round orange lights.
